# Fixture provenance

`upstream/` is an unmodified copy of `tests/paper/fixtures/` from paper-docx
commit `3c0f9a56c73105564a6a44661c6d058a0d3fc800` (MIT; see `/NOTICE.md`).
Every file is hash-frozen by `upstream/MANIFEST.sha256`; the Rust suite
verifies the manifest before using any fixture (`fixture_manifest` test).

Per the upstream README: 31 files are generated by upstream's authoring
scripts, 9 are LibreOffice exports and 1 is a Google Docs export. No
Microsoft Word–authored fixture is included. 40 of 41 sidecars are marked
"UNVERIFIED — agent-authored" upstream; their ground truth has no human
sign-off.

Rust-specific synthetic fixtures are generated in-test from code (see
`crates/docrs/tests/support/`), never committed as opaque binaries.
